title: mnemonica .tactica eds
description: Dive wrap sites and context consumes of one .tactica source (format version 1.0/1.1) — the execution-delegation crossroads, present only where dive exists in the source's stack. Keys are type names or the literal "unknown"; see tactica/README.md.

version.description: Format version. Absent means 1.0 (pre-versioning and 1.0 outputs are identical in shape).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

eds.description: One entry array per owning type name (dotted paths where the generator emits them); sites that could not be attributed to a type sit under "unknown".

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based, relative to the project root — see tactica/README.md "location".

kind.description: The crossroads shape, as emitted by generators today: "wrap" (a dive wrap() call), "contextConsume" (reading dive context, e.g. getFlow(error)), "hookAttach" (registerHook and friends). Open string — readers tolerate values they do not know rather than failing.

code.description: The site as source text (may span lines). Never truncated by the generator.

fn.description: The dive function called ("wrap", ...). Present on wrap sites in current output.

label.description: The wrap(fn, label) grouping label, when one was given.

scope.description: The mnemonica scope name the site belongs to, when resolvable.

scopeId.description: The creation-graph scopeId of the wrapping scope (file path or `file:line:col`).

callbackScopeId.description: The creation-graph scopeId of the wrapped callback body, when it forms its own scope.

instanceArg.description: The context expression passed as the wrap context (variable name or expression text).

via.description: The enclosing wrap site this nested wrap was reached through.

wrapsTypePath.description: The mnemonica type path the wrapped callback is attributed to, when resolvable.

createsTypes.description: Mnemonica type names constructed inside the wrapped callback, when discovered.
